name: Chrome-style
description: Inspired by Classic Chrome: muted greens and yellows, cyan-leaning blues, deep reds, firm contrast, soft highlights. Built on Canon Standard (editable).

description: Inspired by Classic Negative: hard contrast, teal shadows, warm highlights, greens toward teal. Built on Canon Standard (editable).

description: Inspired by Velvia: rich saturation and punchy contrast for landscapes. Built on Canon Standard (editable).

name: Cinema soft

name: Soft portrait

name: Soft slide
